species: Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus, Dermatophagoides farinae, Blomia tropicalis

SPT solutions and allergen vaccines (AVs) from 3 Indian manufacturers that were labeled with "D. pteronyssinus", "D. farinae", "B. tropicalis", and"H" were analyzed by mass spectrometry, gel electrophoresis, and immunoblots using patients’ sera and allergen-specific monoclonal antibodies.
disease_state: It was the aim of this study to corroborate the content of products for diagnosis and treatment of dust mite allergies that are produced and sold in India.
sample_source: All commercial Indian SPT solutions and AVs analyzed in this study are not suitable for dust mite allergy diagnosis and therapy, as they contain either no, or only a limited number of, HDM allergens.
material_type: To guarantee batch-to-batch consistency and reproducibility of diagnostic tests, standardization of allergen extracts is essential.
